summary: Connect a vector-output dense–ReLU layer and all its gradients to an actual TorchLean graph and automatically generated backward.

Verify a separately supplied parallel binary32 implementation with a fixed reduction tree, fresh scratch per round and explicit numerical conditions; the first forward layout places all rows in one bounded cooperating thread array.
remaining: Implemented: actual TorchLean matrix graph and generated VJP; balanced-tree numerical bounds; the shape-specialized forward instruction list, disjoint layout and coordinate/pointer arithmetic; fetched all-thread product execution through its first completed barrier with exact padded product stores and access safety. Four complete software-interpreter cases are tests only. Missing: general execution proofs for later rounds and output stores; actual-access ownership and barrier timing for the full layer; complete memory admission; stored forward numerical correspondence to TorchLean including padding; an empty-output no-launch wrapper; and the parallel backward kernel and its proofs. The product-prefix witness is not a completed or admitted layer execution.

from.quote:
The layer takes an input vector x of length n, a trainable m-by-n weight matrix W,
and a bias vector b of length m. It returns y_i=max(sum_j W_ij*x_j+b_i,0).
Its automatically generated TorchLean backward takes an incoming sensitivity
vector d of length m. With g_i=d_i on a positive affine value and zero otherwise,
it returns dx_j=sum_i W_ij*g_i, dW_ij=g_i*x_j and db_i=g_i. A zero derivative at
an exactly zero affine value is a chosen convention; ordinary mathematical
differentiation requires every relevant affine value to be nonzero.

passage.quote:
theorem forward_coordinate (x : Tensor ℝ (column n)) (w : Tensor ℝ (matrix m n))
    (b : Tensor ℝ (column m)) (row : Fin m) :
    Spec.get2 ((graph m n).forward (inputs x w b)) row 0 =
      max ((∑ j : Fin n, Spec.get2 w row j * Spec.get2 x j 0) + Spec.get2 b row 0) 0 :=

theorem sensitivities_adjoint (x : Tensor ℝ (column n)) (w : Tensor ℝ (matrix m n))
    (b d : Tensor ℝ (column m)) (away : ∀ i, tensorToVec (affine x w b) i ≠ 0) :
    flattenCtx (sensitivities x w b d) =
      (fderiv ℝ (fun v => tensorToVec ((graph m n).forward (unflattenCtx v)))
        (flattenCtx (inputs x w b))).adjoint (tensorToVec d) :=

def program (s : Shape) : List Parallel.Instr :=
  products s ++ (List.range s.depth).flatMap (round s) ++ output s

theorem scratch_injective (s : Shape) (p r c p' r' c' : Nat)
    (hr : r < s.rows) (hc : c < s.width) (hr' : r' < s.rows) (hc' : c' < s.width)
    (same : s.scratch p r c = s.scratch p' r' c') : p=p' ∧ r=r' ∧ c=c' :=

passage.quote:
theorem decoded_coordinates (s : Shape) (b : Bounds s) (t : Fin s.threads) :
    (Scalar.BinOp.eval .and (BitVec.ofNat 32 t.val) (BitVec.ofNat 32 (s.width-1))).toNat = t.val % s.width ∧
    (Scalar.BinOp.eval .shr (BitVec.ofNat 32 t.val) (BitVec.ofNat 32 s.depth)).toNat = t.val / s.width :=

passage.quote:
theorem guarded_load_execution (cfg : Config n) (state : Parallel.State n) (t : Fin n)
    (space : Space) (destination address index : Nat)
    (valid : (state.lanes t).scalar.preds 0 = true →
      Scalar.addressIndex (arena state (some space)) ((state.lanes t).scalar.addrs address) = .ok index) :
    SegmentRegular cfg t [guarded space (.load destination (.reg address))] state ∧
    (segmentReference cfg t [guarded space (.load destination (.reg address))] state).1 =
      afterLoad state t space destination index :=

passage.quote:
theorem product_segment (s : Shape) (b : Bounds s) (state : Parallel.State s.threads) (t : Fin s.threads)
    (tid : (state.lanes t).scalar.regs 0 = BitVec.ofNat 32 t.val)
    (global : s.globalWords ≤ state.global.length) (shared : s.sharedWords ≤ state.shared.length) :
    ∃ events, Segment (config s b) t ((products s).take 21) state events (productFinish s b state t) :=

passage.quote:
theorem product_phase_exists (s : Shape) (b : Bounds s) (global shared : List Word)
    (seeds : Fin s.threads → Scalar.State)
    (globalBound : s.globalWords ≤ global.length) (sharedBound : s.sharedWords ≤ shared.length) :
    ∃ events final, Runs (config s b) (program s) (initial s global shared seeds) events final ∧
      final.global = global ∧ final.shared.length = shared.length ∧
      (∀ t : Fin s.threads, final.shared[t.val]? =
        some (nodeValue s global (t.val/s.width) 0 (t.val%s.width))) ∧
      (∀ t, (final.lanes t).scalar.pc = 22 ∧ (final.lanes t).halted = false) ∧
      final.barrier = Barrier.reset 1 ∧ final.site = none ∧
      (∀ event ∈ events, AccessSafe (initial s global shared seeds) event) :=
